name: c11-check
description: Step C11 books check: 700 s at MAX (seed 5) through N, a wash, a resize, G, a resize back, new springs, the walls' and C11's switches and knobs at runtime, a snapshot saved and loaded; the atoms' and charge's rounding must stay 0

evals.js: { const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.walls.params.on = true; moire.walls.params.cost = false; return 'walls on, cost off'
moire.walls.params.cost = true; moire.walls.params.mature = false; return 'cost on, mature off'
moire.walls.params.mature = true; moire.walls.params.front = false; return 'mature on, front off'
moire.walls.params.front = true; moire.cells.shape.on = false; return 'front on, honeycomb off'
moire.walls.params.turn = false; moire.walls.params.divFront = false; return 'turn off, divfront off'
moire.walls.params.turn = true; moire.walls.params.divFront = true; moire.walls.params.turnGain = 5; moire.walls.params.freeGlue = 0; return 'turn on gain 5, no free glue'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
